subject: POC Observability Plan — FinTechX (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechx.com>, Alex O'Neill <aoneill@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Per our call, here is a concise recap of the proposed POC observability plan and suggested success criteria so we can lock timelines and owners. I attached a one-page checklist and a dashboard template to make onboarding faster.

Summary (POC scope):
- Duration: 2 weeks of active evaluation + 1 week of buffer for follow-ups (target start: 2026-12-01)
- Redwood will deploy a dedicated POC environment (shared model variant) and enable tracing, token-level latency metrics, and log export to a temporary S3 bucket you control.
- Focus areas: end-to-end latency, per-route token cost, top failure/error modes, and quality regressions on a small eval set.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) 95th percentile end-to-end latency for the main inference route under expected test load <= 250ms.
2) Token unit cost reduction baseline established and < X (we'll finalize after sampling).
3) Traceable root cause for any error spike during the POC (stack traces, model variant fallback logs).
4) Observability dashboard with the agreed metrics live and accessible to your team.
5) One knowledge sharing session and runbook handed off to your ops team.

Next steps / owners (proposed):
- Marissa (me): commercial coordination, run weekly check-ins, track success criteria and deliverable sign-off.
- Jordan (ops): instrumentation onboarding, provide sample tracing SDK and guide for request headers.
- Marcus (infra): configure log export, dashboard wiring, and tracing sampler.
- Priya / Alex: grant access to a test workspace and provide the small evaluation prompt set + expected traffic profile.

Attachments: observability_poc_checklist.pdf, dashboard_template.json

Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the Dec 1 start works for your team? If you want any metrics added (e.g., cost-per-inference by route, model fallback counts), tell us and we’ll include them in the dashboard.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex O'Neill <aoneill@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the templates, very helpful. Quick responses from our side:

- Dec 1 start looks fine on our end (we'll reserve the calendar).
- Success criteria look mostly correct. Two small asks:
  1) Can we add "mean time to detect (MTTD) for production-like errors" with a target of < 2 minutes? We'd like to validate detection latency during the POC.
  2) For token unit cost, can Redwood provide a sample estimate from 1000 token sample runs before the start? We want to set an expectation baseline so finance can sign off.

Also, can you confirm whether the dashboard will include sample traces (full span view) or just summarized traces? Alex and security want to understand how much detail is exported.

I'll also loop in our security alias separately for any compliance questions.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product Operations | FinTechX
priya.singh@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechx.com>, Alex O'Neill <aoneill@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan and Success Criteria

Thanks Priya — great points.

I updated the plan to include MTTD < 2 minutes as a success metric and added a line for a pre-POC sample estimate for token costs. Jordan / Marcus: see Priya's asks and confirm below.

Regarding traces: we will surface full span traces in the POC dashboard for debugging, but sampling controls are configurable. For the POC we recommend a 10% full-span sample and 100% summarized spans (latency buckets, error annotations) to balance privacy and volume. Let us know if security needs more restrictive sampling.

Attachments: observability_poc_plan_v2.pdf (updated timeline + metric definitions).

Draft timeline (high level):
- Nov 23–30: access + pre-POC sample runs (Redwood provides token-cost samples and installs small tracing helper).
- Dec 1–14: active POC (monitoring + weekly check-ins).
- Dec 15–18: results, knowledge share, and sign-off.

Jordan: can you confirm the instrumentation guide and an expected ETA for the sample tracing SDK?
Marcus: can you confirm log export destination and that the dashboard template can be wired to the temporary bucket?

Marissa
